trace.final:
Both actions are complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** with an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed rolled out successfully (us-east, us-west, eu-west all on v2.3.0).
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy", describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I verified no incident existed and retried successfully.)

Note: the rollback was to a previously healthy production version (v2.3.0), so no change-manager approval was required.
